title: 第十五章 我是不是做错了什么第十六章 套路都是套路
content_zh:
不管是上辈子，还是这辈子，王盛国坑儿子的样子都一模一样。
上辈子王腾也是和林初涵同桌了一年。
全高中最靓的妞摆在面前，自己却不能动，这是何等的雾草！
后来高中毕业，林初涵去了夏都，就读第一首府大学。
再然后听说是去了国外深造，三年之后回国，展现出非凡的商业才能，短短几年创建公司，布局全国，展望全球，晋升成为一代商业大佬，牛批的不得了。
想想人家，再想想自己……
就像一条咸鱼躺在一头巨鲸面前，还一躺就躺了一整年。
王腾往下看了看林初涵的苗条细腿，有一股想要将其牢牢抱住的冲动。
这大美腿简直镶金的啊！
话说回来，这丫头的身材真是没话说。
林初涵正在背诵课文，突然感觉到一股灼热的视线落在自己大腿上，眉头不知不觉皱了起来。
“哼！”
一声冷哼将王腾惊醒了过来。
王腾看了看林初涵微冷的面容，摸了摸鼻子，呵呵笑了一声，收回了目光。
“还笑，这家伙太可恶了！”
林初涵暗恼。
王腾摇了摇头，暗道自己都是重活一回的人了，定力竟然还是不够，有点丢脸啊！
他取出手机，打算上网查一查高考的资料。
早上王盛国的一番话，让他对高考有了新的认识。
王腾原以为，成为武者之后，地位不同，就不用再去参加高考了。

可没想到其中还有这么多弯弯道道。
幸好王盛国及时提醒，不然还真有可能错过今年的高考。
随便一搜，有关高考的资料跳出来一堆。
不得不说，这个世界和前世的地球，有许多差别，不仔细了解，根本无从得知。
比如，这个世界的地球实际上不叫地球，而是叫地星。
又比如，他们的国家是叫华夏，京都叫夏都，第一首府大学是夏都大学等等。
东海类似于前世的魔都，东海大学是和夏都大学不相上下的重点大学。
而高考时间也有所变动，从6月份推迟到了7月5号。
因为这一天是武道开始推广的时间。
如今的高考以武道考试为重，所以高考时间定在了这具有特殊意义的一天。
王腾又查了下报考武道专业方面的相关内容。
原来，武道考试和普通考试有很大的不同。
武道考试要考的文化课不单单是语数英，理化生这些，还包括了人体学，武道发展史，灵药学，矿物学等等杂七杂八的知识。
content_en:
Whether it was in the previous life or in this life, Wang Shengguo's way of cheating his son was exactly the same.
In his previous life, Wang Teng also sat at the same table with Lin Chuhan for a year.
The most beautiful girl in high school is in front of him, but he can't move. What a fool!
After graduating from high school, Lin Chuhan went to Xiadu to study at First Capital University.
Then I heard that he went abroad for further study, returned to China after three years, and showed extraordinary business talents. In just a few years, he founded a company, spread across the country, and looked to the world, and was promoted to a generation of business tycoons. He was very impressive.
Think about others, then think about yourself...
Like a salted fish lying in front of a giant whale, it has been lying there for a whole year.
Wang Teng looked down at Lin Chuhan's slender legs, and felt the urge to hug them tightly.
These big beautiful legs are simply inlaid with gold!
Having said that, this girl's figure is really nothing to say.
Lin Chuhan was reciting the text when he suddenly felt a burning gaze falling on his thigh, and his brows wrinkled unconsciously.
"Hmph!"
A cold snort woke Wang Teng up.
Wang Teng looked at Lin Chuhan's cold face, touched his nose, laughed, and looked away.
"Still laughing, this guy is so hateful!"
Lin Chuhan was secretly annoyed.
Wang Teng shook his head and thought to himself that he was a man who had been reborn, but his concentration was still not enough, which was a bit embarrassing!
He took out his mobile phone and planned to check the college entrance examination information online.
Wang Shengguo's words in the morning gave him a new understanding of the college entrance examination.
Wang Teng originally thought that after becoming a warrior, his status would be different and he would no longer need to take the college entrance examination.
I didn't expect there to be so many twists and turns.
Fortunately, Wang Shengguo reminded me in time, otherwise I might have missed this year's college entrance examination.
A random search will bring up a lot of information about the college entrance examination.
It has to be said that there are many differences between this world and the earth in the previous life. Without careful understanding, there is no way to know.
For example, the earth in this world is actually not called the earth, but the earth star.
For another example, their country is called Huaxia, Kyoto is called Xiadu, the first capital university is Xiadu University, etc.
Donghai is similar to the Magic City in the previous life, and Donghai University is a key university on par with Xiadu University.
The college entrance examination time has also been changed, postponed from June to July 5.
Because this day is the time when martial arts begins to be promoted.
Today's college entrance examination focuses on martial arts exams, so the college entrance examination is set on this day with special significance.
Wang Teng checked the relevant information about applying for the martial arts major.
It turns out that martial arts exams are very different from ordinary exams.
The cultural courses required for the martial arts exam are not only Chinese, Mathematics, English, Physics and Chemistry, but also miscellaneous knowledge such as human body science, the history of the development of martial arts, elixirs, mineralogy and so on.
